The '''12th Africa Magic Viewers' Choice Awards''' will take place on 9 May 2026 in Lagos, Nigeria. Honouring the best in African film and TV, the award features 32 categories (18 jury-decided and 11 public-voted) and two new categories for North and Central African indigenous language films. The awards are sponsored by Don Julio.
